payload.description: TASK-2. The JSON Schema of this Task type's payload. The Worker's own — this protocol has no data model — and what a consumer renders or validates against.

answeredBy.description: TASK-2. The closed list of Actions that may answer a Task of this type, by the names the Worker's own `actions` entry holds them under. A closed list and not an instruction: the owner names what would answer, never who.

title: Task type declaration
description: TASK-2. One Task type, held under a qualified name (TASK-4, NAME-7) because it is matched by a party that did not mint it.
